description: fakedb/v1 — Simulation leaf that PRODUCES a db_endpoint: on reconcile it derives a deterministic fake endpoint from spec.account_id and writes it to status. The SECOND upstream of the dependency + value-flow demo (sibling of fakevpc); a composer emits a ValueFlow from this status.db_endpoint into a downstream fakeapp's spec, so fakeapp depends on BOTH fakevpc and fakedb.

account_id.description: Account this fake DB lives in; the produced db_endpoint is derived from it.

db_endpoint.description: The produced DB endpoint downstream resources consume via a ValueFlow.
